In this podcast, I sit down with Dris to break down the exact UGC marketing strategy 2026 that helped him generate 100M views in just two weeks. He explains how to build a viral UGC program from scratch and turns this episode into a real creator marketplace startup case study packed with actionable insights.

Dris shares the thinking behind his make money online app strategy, how he leveraged Gen Z creator economy trends, and why his gamified creator platform model was key to scaling fast. We dive deep into how to scale short form content using a repeatable viral content format iteration system and the exact TikTok UGC growth strategy that fueled explosive reach.

He also explains how performance based influencer marketing played a role, how he used organic user acquisition via UGC to drive traction, and the step-by-step creator onboarding and retention strategy that kept creators engaged. For founders, this episode breaks down how to build distribution for AI startups and execute a powerful marketplace cold start strategy without relying on paid ads.

If you're studying UGC marketing strategy 2026, looking to master how to build a viral UGC program, or analyzing a real creator marketplace startup case study, this conversation with Dris gives you the full blueprint.
